source.title: Reverse fixture: JSONConverter masks source errors with file_path KeyError

input.diff_text:
diff --git a/haystack/components/converters/json.py b/haystack/components/converters/json.py
index 102137d..9dd79bd 100644
--- a/haystack/components/converters/json.py
+++ b/haystack/components/converters/json.py
@@ -191,7 +191,7 @@ class JSONConverter:
         except UnicodeError as exc:
             logger.warning(
                 "Failed to extract text from {source}. Skipping it. Error: {error}",
-                source=source.meta.get("file_path", "unknown"),
+                source=source.meta["file_path"],
                 error=exc,
             )
             return []
@@ -204,7 +204,7 @@ class JSONConverter:
             except Exception as exc:
                 logger.warning(
                     "Failed to extract text from {source}. Skipping it. Error: {error}",
-                    source=source.meta.get("file_path", "unknown"),
+                    source=source.meta["file_path"],
                     error=exc,
                 )
                 return []
@@ -216,7 +216,7 @@ class JSONConverter:
             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                 logger.warning(
                     "Failed to extract text from {source}. Skipping it. Error: {error}",
-                    source=source.meta.get("file_path", "unknown"),
+                    source=source.meta["file_path"],
                     error=exc,
                 )
                 return []

issues.description: All three JSONConverter exception handlers index source.meta['file_path'] while handling decoding, jq filtering, or JSON parsing failures. Bare ByteStream inputs legitimately have no file_path metadata, so the handlers raise KeyError and mask the original error instead of warning and skipping the bad source as intended.
issues.repair_unit: use safe metadata access consistently across JSONConverter error handlers
issues.mechanism_pattern: exception handlers unconditionally index optional file_path metadata
issues.invariant_pattern: error handling must preserve the original failure and tolerate ByteStream inputs without file_path metadata
